concerns.text: FR-003 mandates a sensitivity sweep calculating 'top-20 CRE overlap percentage' across FDR thresholds (0.01, 0.05, 0.10). Task T041 is marked as unchecked and contains a comment 'FAILED: unspecified', leaving this mandatory requirement unimplemented.

FR-014 requires validation of distal CREs using Hi-C contact frequency from the 'Yeast 3D Genome Atlas'. Task T042 (Hi-C download) is marked as unchecked with a comment 'FAILED: unspecified', meaning the data source for a mandatory gating filter is missing.
SC-005 requires verification of summit match correlation (ρ ≥ 0.8) for top-10 CREs. Tasks T032 (implementation) and T033 (integration) are both unchecked, leaving this success criterion unverified.
FR-017 requires a sensitivity analysis comparing β₁ estimates between full and filtered CRE sets to quantify selection bias. Task T026 is unchecked, leaving this requirement unaddressed.
FR-013 requires independent ATAC-seq validation (or a logged skip). Task T034 is unchecked, leaving the data quality check incomplete.
User Story 1 requires an independent integration test on mock data. Task T012 is unchecked and marked 'FAILED: unspecified', leaving the US1 test coverage incomplete.

Tasks T001 (directory structure) and T004 (Git LFS) are marked as failed/re-planned but remain in the active list without a clear re-planned sub-task to generate the required artifacts, risking implementation start without necessary infrastructure.
